description: A tool call (such as `transfer_to_billing`) that switches the active agent; the receiving agent continues the conversation and answers the user.
Peer agents coordinating through handoffs or shared state without a central planner. Flexible but hard to predict. `emerging`.
Which agent may transfer to which. A design decision and a permission boundary: forbidden transfers are rejected.
Two agents handing control back and forth (A, B, A, B). A sign of overlapping or missing ownership; stop and escalate.
The maximum number of transfers in one conversation, bounding the length of the chain.
A rule that decides how much of the conversation the next agent sees: everything, a summary, or the history without tool calls.
